label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee feast/celebration for the mayor in the town hall great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves replacing a mouldy batch and eight installed lanterns. Innkeeper, builder and freight coordinated funding, baking, deliveries and the mayor's arrival. Baker knowingly supplied the final 44 loaves and promised secrecy; secretary knowingly helped preserve the presentation's private contents and arrange exact arrival, but is not shown knowing the full jubilee/feast plan. The mayor was told about and approved a civic presentation of thanks, so the event's existence was not wholly secret; the jubilee surprise and feast preparations were withheld. No sufficient evidence that neighbour knowingly joined or helped conceal the surprise.
